title: Phase 1 Validation: Hydration After Restart
description:
Verify playback works after restart even when in-memory caches are empty.

Test steps:
1. Ensure Brief queue has items
2. Force close app completely
3. Relaunch app
4. Attempt to play queued items

Expected: Playback works - Core Data hydration fetches Article/RSSEpisode by stored IDs.
